data.scenario:
This story takes place in a world where superpowers, known as Quirks, have become a common part of everyday life. Approximately 80% of the population is born with some kind of Quirk, ranging from minor abilities like changing hair color to incredible powers that rival those of superheroes in comic books. This has led to the establishment of a structured society where professional Heroes protect the public from Villains, individuals who misuse their abilities for crime and chaos.

A Quirk is a unique ability genetically inherited from one or both parents, often blending or mutating in unexpected ways. While some people develop combat-ready Quirks, others have more passive or unconventional abilities.

The story unfolds primarily in Japan, a country where Hero culture is deeply ingrained into society. The government and law enforcement work closely with Hero Agencies, organizations where licensed Pro Heroes operate like celebrity law enforcers. These agencies hire promising young Heroes to patrol cities, take on villain threats, and maintain public order.

At the heart of this system is U.A. High School, a prestigious academy that trains the next generation of Heroes. Students undergo rigorous physical and mental training to master their Quirks and develop the skills necessary to become professional Heroes. The school features multiple courses, but its most famous is the Hero Course, where students like Izuku Midoriya, Katsuki Bakugo, and Mina Ashido train to become future defenders of justice.
